comments.text: That depends on what you mean by "Church-Turing thesis": * [LINK] The Interactive Nature of Computing: Refuting the Strong Church-Turing Thesis (Published version here: [LINK] ) * [LINK] See also a previous hacker news discussion of the Church-Turing thesis here: [LINK] albeit I take issue with the supposed "proof" by counter example via Compass & Straightedge construction given in the video there, due to results like these two: * [LINK] Kellison, Ariel; Bickword, Mark; Constable, Robert L. - Implementing Euclid’s straightedge and compass constructions in type theory [September 2018] (Code here: [LINK] ) * [LINK] (Numerous papers by Michael Beeson et al., just check the page, I won't link them all here) (Note that the authors of the two above works take very different yet similar approaches to the whole matter, it really pays off to compare both to each other.)
